title: RealTalk-CN: A Realistic Chinese Speech-Text Dialogue Benchmark With Cross-Modal Interaction Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating speech-based language model performance on intent classification and slot filling tasks across different speaker age groups. The study uses statistical significance tests (Kruskal-Wallis H, Mann-Whitney U) and effect size measurements (Cohen's d) to quantify performance degradation when processing the speech of older demographics (e.g., 45-54 year olds) compared to younger users.

Comparing semantic parsing performance (intent classification and slot filling) across speakers from various geographical regions in China (e.g., North, South, Southwest, Northwest). This assesses how models trained primarily on standard Mandarin degrade when processing diverse regional accents and dialectal features.
